name: Incubi

bonuses.name: Champion
bonuses.text: This Threat may use Ruin Actions and has 12 personal Ruin.

bonuses.name: Power from Pain: Mantle of Agony
bonuses.text: If this Threat deals a Wound it gains +2 bonus dice to Intimidation Tests until the end of its next Turn.

abilities.name: Lethal Precision
abilities.text: When an Incubus successfully hits with a Wrath Critical in melee they deal +4 Mortal Wounds.

abilities.name: Tormentors
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin to target an individual or a Mob. The Incubus makes an Intimidation Test opposed by its target's Leadership. If the Incubus wins, the target suffers the Fear Condition.

note: Print: the Champion bonus prints 12 personal Ruin (a Succubus has 3, an Archon 4); the Klaive prints "8 + 7 ED"; the skill is printed "Intimidate".
